name: parallel-group-keeps-spread-field-update
description: Port-only. A program node also spreads its output fields into the flow state. Steps a and b share a parallel group and the input already holds summary; a writes a new summary, b doesn't touch it. The group merges each step's changes, so a's summary survives b, as running them one after another would leave it. Merging whole states put back the input's summary.
